chunks: You will see the mountains, thinking them firm, while they pass like passing clouds: [the] artistry of God who perfected everything. Indeed, He is Acquainted with what you do.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the mountains on the Day of Resurrection according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to illustrate the transient nature of worldly power and the certainty of the Hereafter, emphasizing that even the most stable creations are subject to God's will. It serves as a reminder of Allah's 'Itqan' (perfection) in creation and His 'Khbir' (all-knowing) nature regarding human deeds, reinforcing the concept of divine justice.
